subject: Altman: OpenAI IPO in 2026 would be 'ill-advised' (Fortune)

metrics.headline: Altman: OpenAI IPO in 2026 would be 'ill-advised' (Fortune)
metrics.body_excerpt: Sam Altman told Fortune an OpenAI IPO in 2026 would be ill-advised, citing unfinished safety and alignment work. Markets had been pricing a 2026 listing; keeping the company private preserves the option to pause training without public-shareholder pressure.
